description: Turn registry skills on or off for a deployed agent, and optionally move it from Starter to Pro, as one billed change. Skills set the agent's monthly price and monthly credits. On a team agent only a team admin or the person who deployed the agent can change its skills; other members are refused and nothing is charged. Steps: 1) call without confirm. The tool checks the names, adds the skills they depend on, and returns the current and new monthly price, what Wiro charges or credits now, the credits this period gains or loses, the scheduled tasks it stops or starts, and an idempotency_key. Nothing changes yet. 2) Show the price to the user. 3) After they approve, call again with confirm: true and that idempotency_key. The key is tied to the quoted prices and, on a prepaid plan, the billing period: if either changed since the quote, nothing is applied and a new quote with a new key comes back. Reusing the key after a timeout is safe, the change is applied once. Billing: on a prepaid plan the monthly difference for the time left in the period is taken from the wallet at once, and the added credits come for that same time; every renewal gives all of them. When the price drops, what the time left is worth goes back to the balances that paid, less 1 cent for each credit already used above what the plan keeps, and each balance keeps its own end date. A skill that comes off loses its credits for the time left; the ones the time already passed paid for stay until the renewal. On a card plan nothing is charged at once: the card subscription is updated to the new price, a plan that renews by card shows the difference on its next invoice, and the added credits come for the time left. A running agent restarts once when a skill turns on or off; a change of the tier alone leaves it running. Newly enabled skills may still need credentials (set_agent_credentials, connect_agent_oauth, bind_agent_project for a Wiro project) and do not create scheduled tasks (manage_agent_custom_skill does). Find skill names with list_agent_skills and the agent's current skills with get_my_agent. The agents playbook (get_playbook) has the full setup walkthrough.

add_dependencies.description: Also turn on the skills that the enabled skills depend on (default true). Without them the change is refused.

agent_guid.description: The deployed agent's guid, from list_my_agents.

confirm.description: false (default) only returns the quote. true applies the change and charges it; it needs the idempotency_key from the quote.

idempotency_key.description: With confirm: true, the key from the quote the user approved. It ties the approval to the quoted prices and, on a prepaid plan, the billing period, and repeating the call with it after a timeout never applies the change twice. Omit it to get a quote.

skills.description: Skills to change, as name: true to turn on or name: false to turn off, for example {"int-instagram-post": true}. Registry names only (list_agent_skills). Custom skills and scheduled tasks (cs-...) are managed with manage_agent_custom_skill; channels such as Telegram turn on through set_agent_credentials.

tier.description: Optional: also move from Starter to Pro in this billed change. To upgrade without a skill change, use manage_agent_billing (upgrade_to_pro).

name: apply_agent_skills

creditNowUsd.description: For a drop on a wallet plan, what goes back to the balances that paid; null when it is worked out when the change is applied.

estimatedChargeNowUsd.description: What a wallet plan pays now at list price, as Wiro works it out, before any discount on the wallet; 0 on a card plan, whose difference goes to the card subscription.

usedCreditsUsd.description: The part of a credit that comes off for credits already used above what the plan keeps.

pausedTasks.description: After an applied change: the scheduled tasks it paused, which wait for skills that are off. get_my_agent names those skills.

creditsFromRenewal.description: The monthly credits every renewal grants after the change.

creditsNow.description: The credits this period gains now, below 0 when it loses them: the change counts for the time left in the period.

creditsThisPeriod.description: The monthly credits this period grants in all after the change.

currentMonthlyCredits.description: The monthly credits each renewal grants now.

newMonthlyCredits.description: The monthly credits each renewal grants after the change.

resume.description: Scheduled tasks that do not run now and start running once this change is applied, and the agent is running.

stop.description: Scheduled tasks this change stops: they run now, or would once an agent that is not running starts. They keep their text, schedule and on/off state, and get_my_agent then shows what each waits for.

scheduledTasks.description: Quote: the scheduled tasks this change stops or starts, as Wiro works it out; null when Wiro could not tell.

title: Change an agent's skills
